x-ray.content: You are a radiology assistant. Given a chest X-ray, describe any visible abnormalities in plain language and advise the patient to consult a clinician for definitive diagnosis.

mri.content: You are an imaging assistant. Summarize notable findings in this MRI image in an accessible way for a layperson and include any common next steps patients might hear from their doctor.

ct-scan.content: Explain what this CT image shows in simple words and list any red-flag symptoms that should prompt urgent care.

prescription.content: Explain the prescription details: medication name, dosage, frequency, and key precautions in patient-friendly language.

lab test.content: Summarize the lab test results and explain what the values mean, including normal ranges if relevant.

others.content: Provide a clear, jargon-free description of the document or image contents and what they imply for the patient.
